objections.detail: _verify_audit accepts a six-field synthetic pass document with no auditor_id, reviewed test command/result, checks, objections, or notes. The static root token is then sufficient to release the run. The exact audit schema/all-pass checks are not enforced.

Extractor trusts transcript_so_far without ordering/pre-action validation; a synthetic round-99 item changes features. If public_parameters is empty it falls back to full configuration, and hidden incomplete-information deltas alter the canonical config effect. Exact source hash matches, but the frozen extractor does not fail closed against the required future/private leakage attacks.

_trajectory_rows drops the censored row, then uses max round/count among remaining stop-observed prefixes as the actual terminal target and forces residual survival mass onto that prefix. Missing callbacks are therefore converted into terminal-round/action-count targets despite the censoring contract.

OperationalV1Predictor discards sampled archetype identity. Its offer_distribution always applies target_share - concession_rate * own_offer_index, while exact schema-v1 BargainingPolicy freezes early offers for the present `boulware` archetype before 75% of horizon. Thus the mandatory operational-v1 offer/trajectory comparator is not the exact policy named in the contract.

Inner selection is outer-training-only, but computes mean of three fold means. With unequal hash-fold game counts this is not the frozen unweighted mean over games. validation_loss also averages all row/channel loss entries within game rather than an explicit frozen joint channel aggregate. Hyperparameter selection can change.

event_id is copied without nonempty/unique validation and no canonical row_id is built. Two empty IDs are accepted, so exact once-per-axis row reconciliation and coherent duplicate detection are not mechanically auditable.

No RLIMIT/RSS limiter exists. CPU, RSS, and artifact ceilings are checked only after a fold, and extraction has no artifact-size guard; a process can exceed the hard 8 CPU-hour/12 GiB/3 GiB limits before detection or OOM without an atomic failure certificate. The 90-minute parent timeout is enforced.

The frozen campaign requires separate diagnostics on immutable Jordan-reached branch labels. The result only lists those labels and records exact rescoring as pending; no implementation produces the required diagnostic.
